headline: Mooring County Front Reignites While Weathered Expanse Clashes Intensify
war_summary: Mooring County has resumed active strategic base exchanges over the past two hours, with contested positions around Gravekeeper's Holdfast and The Cut driving fierce engagements alongside heavy casualty rates on both sides. In Weathered Expanse, unrelenting fighting persists at fever pitch, generating continuous base transfers across Crow's Nest and Frostmarch as casualty figures accelerate sharply into the latest hour. Stlican Shelf has also stirred back to life, recording fresh strategic shifts centered on Fort Hoarfrost. By contrast, base turnover in Stonecradle has cooled over the latest two hours following earlier turmoil, though fighting remains punishing for defending elements. Immense attrition continues without direct territorial shifts in Callahan's Passage and Farranac Coast, where rising enlistments and escalating butcher bills signal intense pressure along fortified sectors. Meanwhile, quiet has largely held across peripheral theaters such as Fishermans Row and Linn of Mercy after prior days of contention.
